verses.text: For the one directing. A Psalm of David, in the coming of Nathan the prophet to him after that he had gone in to Bathsheba. Have mercy on me O God, according to Your loving devotion; according to the abundance of Your compassion, wipe out my transgressions.

segments.text: For the one directing. A Psalm of David, in the coming of Nathan the prophet to him after that he had gone in to Bathsheba. Have mercy on me O God, according to Your loving devotion; according to the abundance of Your compassion, wipe out my transgressions.

verses.text: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

segments.text: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

verses.text: For I know my transgressions, and my sin [is] before me continually.

segments.text: For I know my transgressions, and my sin [is] before me continually.

verses.text: Against You, You alone, have I sinned, and have done the evil in your eyes, so that You are right when You speak, and You are pure when You judge.

segments.text: Against You, You alone, have I sinned, and have done the evil in your eyes, so that You are right when You speak, and You are pure when You judge.

verses.text: Behold, in iniquity I was brought forth, and in sin my mother conceived me.

segments.text: Behold, in iniquity I was brought forth, and in sin my mother conceived me.

verses.text: Behold, You take delight [in] truth in the inner parts; in the inmost place You teach me wisdom.

segments.text: Behold, You take delight [in] truth in the inner parts; in the inmost place You teach me wisdom.

verses.text: Cleanse my sin with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

segments.text: Cleanse my sin with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

verses.text: Make me hear joy and gladness; let the bones You have crushed rejoice.

segments.text: Make me hear joy and gladness; let the bones You have crushed rejoice.

verses.text: May You hide Your face from my sins, and wipe out all my iniquities.

segments.text: May You hide Your face from my sins, and wipe out all my iniquities.

verses.text: Create a clean heart in me, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.

segments.text: Create a clean heart in me, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.

verses.text: Do not cast me away from before Your face, and do not take away from me Your Holy Spirit.

segments.text: Do not cast me away from before Your face, and do not take away from me Your Holy Spirit.

verses.text: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and uphold me [by a] willing spirit.

segments.text: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and uphold me [by a] willing spirit.

verses.text: I will teach transgressors Your ways, and sinners will return to You.

segments.text: I will teach transgressors Your ways, and sinners will return to You.

verses.text: Deliver me from bloodguilt, O God, the God of my salvation; my tongue will sing of Your righteousness.

segments.text: Deliver me from bloodguilt, O God, the God of my salvation; my tongue will sing of Your righteousness.

verses.text: O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.

segments.text: O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.

verses.text: For You do not take delight [in] sacrifice, or I would give [it]; [with] a burnt offering You are not pleased.

segments.text: For You do not take delight [in] sacrifice, or I would give [it]; [with] a burnt offering You are not pleased.

verses.text: The sacrifices of God [are] a broken spirit. A heart broken and crushed, O God, You will not despise.

segments.text: The sacrifices of God [are] a broken spirit. A heart broken and crushed, O God, You will not despise.

verses.text: By Your pleasure, do good to Zion; may You build up the walls of Jerusalem.

segments.text: By Your pleasure, do good to Zion; may You build up the walls of Jerusalem.

verses.text: Then You will delight [in] the sacrifices of righteousness, a burnt offering and whole [sacrifice]; then they will offer bulls upon Your altar.

segments.text: Then You will delight [in] the sacrifices of righteousness, a burnt offering and whole [sacrifice]; then they will offer bulls upon Your altar.
